summary: Inside a completed I/O callback, preserve Node ordering where setImmediate runs before a newly scheduled zero-delay timeout.

requirements.scheduling_context: I/O callback running from poll phase

target.notes: Use the Node-compatible event-loop runtime; do not map ordering to arbitrary Task/ThreadPool scheduling.

semantics.ordering: Immediate runs in the following check phase before the newly eligible zero-delay timeout
semantics.reason: the callback is already in the poll phase; check follows before the next timers opportunity

caveats: Do not generalize this deterministic I/O-callback ordering to top-level scheduling.
Node timer delays are thresholds and 0 is normalized to the minimum delay.

tests.name: requires poll/I/O context
tests.expected_behavior: this rule does not fix an order at top level
